FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'

FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'
ORDER BY c.name
LIMIT 100
